modelAssumptions: Apply the broker's published Cascadia 2021 Amplia category price to one Mexican planning tractor, not an observed policy for the RODAL VIN, DD15 engine, manual transmission or insured value.
The year table uses the same version across years but does not publish its exact version or 2021 insured value. Do not scale the 2022 premium by asking-price ratio or substitute a 2022 row.
116952MXN is the published annual total rounded to whole pesos. The 30% convenio discount, policy right790MXN and IVA are already included. No further discount or fee is applied.
Use gross premium as an explicit planning measurement without deducting a tax credit. Actual VAT recoverability and net economic expense remain unknown, not asserted as zero.
Cash and asset-financed alternatives use the same annual coverage reference; premium installment finance and lender-specific requirements are not modeled.
The source excludes the trailer and cargo. US, border, interchange, trailer and merchandise coverage are not proved by this domestic tractor benchmark and remain separate unresolved conditions.
Normalize annual/12 once, then convert with the dated Banxico FIX reference and round USD monthly cents only. Not a monthly invoice, current insurer quote, canonical parameter or negotiated tariff.
